description.value: Sushi Wara is a Japanese sushi restaurant located in Delta in the Greater Vancouver area, offering dine-in, takeout, and online ordering. The restaurant notably calls out its Delta location to distinguish itself from a similarly named place in Comox. A touring cyclist passing through the Scott Road corridor would find a full sit-down Japanese meal or a quick takeout option here.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 98m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a real, operating Japanese restaurant at 6485 120 St, Delta, BC with full hours listed. OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's 'Order Online' feature. A phone number discrepancy exists: OSM lists +1-604-596-4400 but the website shows (604) 596-4460 (last two digits differ). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM lists +1-604-596-4400 but website shows (604) 596-4460. Last two digits differ — one of these may be incorrect.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating restaurant confirmed by website with full hours and online ordering. A useful food stop for touring cyclists on the Scott Road corridor.
